title: DevHarness Implementation Join Output
description: Producer output contract for joining implementation branch outputs before review dispatch.

outcome.description: Producer must emit the single enum value that reflects the completed stage state; use blocked only when blocker explains the recoverable pause.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for this output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when this says blocked or needs revision.

reviewer_handoff.description: Producer may emit a legacy aggregate reviewer handoff for human summary only. Downstream reviewer prompts should prefer reviewer_handoffs.<review_step_id>.
reviewer_handoff.x-usage: Use this only as coarse summary context. Prefer reviewer_handoffs for reviewer-specific prompts to avoid repeating unrelated evidence.

selected_review_steps.description: Producer must exactly copy planning_draft.selected_review_steps so schema validation can require a matching reviewer-specific handoff for each selected reviewer.
selected_review_steps.x-usage: Use this as the dispatch coverage list. Every listed review step must have a sibling reviewer_handoffs.<review_step_id> entry.

reviewer_handoffs.description: Producer must emit compact reviewer-specific handoffs keyed by selected review step id.
reviewer_handoffs.x-usage: Route each reviewer only the matching handoff. Do not send every reviewer the aggregate implementation bundle by default.

artifacts.description: Producer may emit named structured artifacts created by this stage when they are part of the handoff.
artifacts.x-usage: Use these only as supporting named artifacts to preserve or pass along. Do not treat them as routing decisions unless another field explicitly references them.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps, blockers, or approved contracts.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the relevant decision or handoff in concise human-readable form without adding new scope.
summary.x-usage: Use this as concise human-readable context only. Do not route, approve, or expand scope from this text.

source_step_id.description: Producer must name the workflow step id that found or owns this blocker or finding.
source_step_id.x-usage: Use this to identify the step that found or owns the blocker/finding. Do not treat it as a retry target by itself.

needed.description: Producer must state the exact missing decision, permission, input, or evidence required to proceed.
needed.x-usage: Surface this exact missing input, permission, evidence, or decision before proceeding. Do not substitute assumptions for it.

evidence.description: Producer should list concrete evidence references supporting this handoff, verdict, finding, or blocker.
evidence.x-usage: Use these references to inspect or challenge the claim. Do not assume unreferenced surfaces were checked.

risk.description: Producer should describe the residual risk if this blocker or finding is ignored.
risk.x-usage: Use this to understand why ignoring the item is unsafe. Treat it as risk context unless paired with a blocked outcome.

blocker.description: Producer must populate this when outcome is blocked, naming the recoverable pause reason, owning step, and specific missing input or permission.
blocker.x-usage: Treat this as a recoverable pause. Surface the missing input or decision, then continue this same workflow step after it is resolved.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the relevant decision or handoff in concise human-readable form without adding new scope.
summary.x-usage: Use this as concise human-readable context only. Do not route, approve, or expand scope from this text.

selected_implementation_steps.description: Producer must list the implementation branches represented in this reviewer-specific handoff.
selected_implementation_steps.x-usage: Use this to verify which implementation branches are relevant to this reviewer. Do not assume missing branches are complete.

review_focus.description: Producer should list the exact reviewer-specific surfaces, risks, or contracts this reviewer must inspect.
review_focus.x-usage: Use this to scope the reviewer prompt. Do not expand beyond this focus unless the approved plan requires it.

changed_files.description: Producer may list files or zones relevant to this reviewer.
changed_files.x-usage: Use this as inspection guidance only; verify against implementation evidence before concluding.

evidence.description: Producer should list concrete evidence references supporting this reviewer-specific handoff.
evidence.x-usage: Use these references to inspect or challenge the claim. Do not assume unreferenced surfaces were checked.

reviewerHandoff.description: Producer must aggregate only the implementation evidence relevant to one reviewer step.
reviewerHandoff.x-usage: Treat this as a reviewer-specific evidence bundle, not as approval that the implementation is correct.
